1.web: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
1.asv: The plans of the heart belong to man; But the answer of the tongue is from Jehovah.

2.web: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.
2.asv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the spirits.

3.web: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
3.asv: Commit thy works unto Jehovah, And thy purposes shall be established.

4.web: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
4.asv: Jehovah hath made everything for its own end; Yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

5.web: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.
5.asv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to Jehovah: Thoughhandjoinin hand, he shall not be unpunished.

6.web: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
6.asv: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for; And by the fear of Jehovah men depart from evil.

7.web: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
7.asv: When a man’s ways please Jehovah, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

8.web: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
8.asv: Better is a little, with righteousness, Than great revenues with injustice.

9.web: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
9.asv: A man’s heart deviseth his way; But Jehovah directeth his steps.

10.web: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
10.asv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king; His mouth shall not transgress in judgment.

11.web: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
11.asv: A just balance and scales are Jehovah’s; All the weights of the bag are his work.

12.web: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
12.asv: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness; For the throne is established by righteousness.

13.web: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
13.asv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; And they love him that speaketh right.

14.web: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
14.asv: The wrath of a king isasmessengers of death; But a wise man will pacify it.

15.web: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
15.asv: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; And his favor is as a cloud of the latter rain.

16.web: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
16.asv: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! Yea, to get understanding is rather to be chosen than silver.

17.web: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
17.asv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: He that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

18.web: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
18.asv: Pridegoethbefore destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.

19.web: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
19.asv: Better it is to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.

20.web: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
20.asv: He that giveth heed unto the word shall find good; And whoso trusteth in Jehovah, happy is he.

21.web: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
21.asv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent; And the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

22.web: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
22.asv: Understanding is a well-spring of life unto him that hath it; But the correction of fools istheirfolly.

23.web: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
23.asv: The heart of the wise instructeth his mouth, And addeth learning to his lips.

24.web: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
24.asv: Pleasant words areas a honeycomb, Sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

25.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
25.asv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, But the end thereof are the ways of death.

26.web: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
26.asv: The appetite of the laboring man laboreth for him; For his mouth urgeth him thereto.

27.web: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
27.asv: A worthless man deviseth mischief; And in his lips there is as a scorching fire.

28.web: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
28.asv: A perverse man scattereth abroad strife; And a whisperer separateth chief friends.

29.web: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
29.asv: A man of violence enticeth his neighbor, And leadeth him in a way that is not good.

30.web: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
30.asv: He that shutteth his eyes, it is to devise perverse things: He that compresseth his lips bringeth evil to pass.

31.web: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
31.asv: The hoary head is a crown of glory; It shall be found in the way of righteousness.

32.web: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
32.asv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; And he that ruleth his spirit, than he that taketh a city.

33.web: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
33.asv: The lot is cast into the lap; But the whole disposing thereof is of Jehovah.
